data.text:
VOYAGER: During the midday downpour earlier today, almost five days' worth of rain fell in Quezon City in just two hours, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA). 

The heavy rain affected several areas, including the Loyola Heights Campus, which experienced ankle-deep flooding along Dela Costa Hall, Gates 2 and 3.5, and Zen Garden. The water has since subsided. 

A total of 82 millimeters of precipitation was recorded at the PAGASA Science Garden station between 11 AM and 1 PM. According to the weather bureau, the rain was caused by an intense thunderstorm affecting northern and central Metro Manila, as well as parts of Rizal and Bulacan. 

Notably, a similar event occurred on August 30, when seven days' worth of rain fell in Quezon City in just one hour.
